doctrine: The ISSUE-002 translation table, made public. Each entry declares that a published indicator's payload cells at one geographic level are drawn from master rows stored under DIFFERENT variable ids (English/Spanish legacy splits, boundary-vintage restatements, census-retrospective year stamps). Both the publisher and the downloader read this register: scripts/run_m028.py ships the mapped master variables' rows in the curated download (under their as-printed master names, source-fidelity doctrine), and tools/g8_display_download.py accepts them as backing for the indicator's rendered cells. An entry requires evidence: every payload cell it legitimizes must be value-identical to a promotable, unfenced master row under the mapped id at the same (level, year, unit). Payload cells no entry can back are pruned by scripts/prune_unbacked_payload_cells.py, never kept on faith. Registered from the 2026-08-19 external-audit reconciliation (G8); evidence counts are payload cells verified value-identical at registration time.

Electoral districts coincide with departments before 1891 (GEO_LEVEL_PENDING['constituency'], extraction_output/pipeline.py); master stores n_legislators at its as-printed constituency level (BCN Legislators Database, decade years 1830-1890, 425 rows; the 1830 sample is wholly needs_review and never projects). Step B projects a constituency row onto the department payload only when its unit resolves to exactly ONE department dcode via dept_mapping.resolve and only one as-printed district maps to that department that year: combined districts ('Ancud y Quinchao', 'Lebu, Cañete y Arauco'), province or corporate seats ('Provincia de Aconcagua', 'Comisión Conservadora'), and collision keys (Curicó 1850; Loncomilla/San Javier 1870, 1880) are skipped, never split or summed. The curated download ships the as-printed constituency rows unchanged (fidelity doctrine); G8 accepts a department payload cell backed by an equal-value curated constituency row at the same year and unit slug.
